errors.description: The model incorrectly perceived the top face of the reference cube as red and the right face as blue, when according to the ground truth, the top face was green and the right face was yellow. This misperception led the model to incorrectly match the cube to Option D, which has a red top and blue right face, instead of Option B, which correctly matches the green top and yellow right face. This is a core perception error that cascaded into an incorrect final answer.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed due to a fundamental perception error: it misidentified the colors on the visible faces of the reference cube. Instead of seeing green on top and yellow on the right, it hallucinated red on top and blue on the right. This error directly caused it to select Option D instead of the correct Option B. The reasoning logic following this misperception was internally consistent but built on false visual input, making the failure rooted in perception rather than reasoning.
